name: Brann Holt
look: a broad-shouldered, heavyset man of about forty with a square weathered face, short-cropped black hair, a thick short black beard with a grey streak at the chin, a pale scar cutting through his left eyebrow, and dark brown eyes. He wears a worn brown leather brigandine studded with dull iron rivets over a faded rust-red padded gambeson, a single dented steel pauldron on his right shoulder only, thick leather bracers, a wide belt with a plain longsword in a scabbard at his left hip, and a round wooden shield with an iron boss and a chipped red rim slung on his back
voice: a deep, gravelly, slow baritone with a dry, flat, grumbling delivery
personality: Blunt, proud, impatient, loyal to the bone. Thinks in terms of pay, ale and getting it over with. Goes first, always, and never admits he is hurt.
speech: Short plain sentences. Understatement. Complains about pay. Never uses a long word if a grunt will do.
voice_prompt: a very deep, gravelly, slow bass voice, dry and grumbling

files.portrait: brann_portrait.webp (hero reference, use for every still)
files.sheet: brann_sheet.webp (full body, three views; add for full-body and back shots)
files.voice_sample: voice.mp3 (14 s; shared by public link for models that take a voice recording, e.g. Seedance: refer to it as @Audio1 and name whose voice it is)

voice_sample_made_with: bytedance-seed/seed-audio-1-0, voice described in the text prompt
how_to_use: Stills: pass portrait (and sheet) as reference images and repeat the `look` text. Video with dialogue: write the line as: <tag>, says in <voice_prompt>: "...". Keep `look`, `voice_prompt` and tag wording identical between films.
tag: Brann, the big black-bearded man in leather armour
relationship: Brann and Fenn are old friends and adventuring partners who bicker constantly.
voice_archetype: gruff deep-bass veteran (big, bearded, around forty)
casting_rule: The look largely decides the voice a video model gives a character, so two characters of the same look type will sound alike. No two characters in one production may share a voice archetype; on a clash, change the look or age of one before any shot is rendered.
